label: late-episode (low value) while policy favors a2; silent on S1 at D2
explanation: Fires only in the last ~20 trials of the 100-trial episode (none before trial 70; 94% of mass in trials 90-99), i.e. when the model value head is low (97% of mass at value < 5.22), and mostly when the policy logit favors a2 (choice < -1.5; 95% of mass on trials where the agent picks a2, good=S2). Never active at D2 when S1 is shown. Scored predicate uses only observed/model-internal quantities (value, choice, state input). Magnitude grows toward the episode end and is higher at GO and at D1 after reward; also fires strongly on rare d1 errors and penalty inputs. Misses: weak late-episode activations on a1-choosing trials; false positives: low-value a2 steps where it stays silent. Dev F1 0.74, mass recall 0.88.
